collection.description: A new healer proposes experimental operations, while an elder favors familiar treatments and cautious observation.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A new healer proposes experimental operations, while an elder favors familiar treatments and cautious observation.

choices.label: Allow innovation with patient consent and careful records.
Create a council to review risky treatments.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A failed procedure leads to stricter safeguards rather than a ban on questions.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Patients receive more predictable care, though some new ideas are delayed.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The young healer begins safer studies of anatomy and hygiene.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The council includes healers, patients, and elders, and disagreements become more thoughtful.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The council struggles to agree but establishes a rule against treating patients without consent.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: A new technique helps a patient, but its risks remain unknown.
